summary: Implemented and deployed an identity-only system principal in Keystone. The first production principal is structurally separate from users, has no login surface, no credential schema or issuance surface, and no authorization grant.

scope_deviation.decision: defer credential issuance and introspection until Rikune integration
scope_deviation.reason: Independent security review found that immediate activation before durable secret delivery would leave crash and path-race ambiguity. The production release was narrowed to the user-requested inert bootstrap identity.
scope_deviation.follow_up_gate: pending -> secure deliver -> active, bounded TTL, rotation, and auditable introspection
